# Michael Dever & Associates

> Specialist English translation, writing, editing and independent review for finance, investor relations and corporate communications in Switzerland.

Michael Dever & Associates has served the Swiss business community since 2006. The firm combines experience in financial services with specialist language expertise and a close understanding of corporate communications. It produces texts and reviews work prepared elsewhere, including drafts produced by people or AI. For multilingual projects, it coordinates with trusted colleagues. Locations are Geneva and Charmey; the firm works in English, French and German.

## Services
- English-language translation
- Content writing
- Editing and revision
- Independent review before publication

Typical assignments: annual and interim reports, earnings releases, investor presentations, sustainability disclosures, websites and speeches. Reviews examine terminology, consistency, tone and the meaning the audience will take away. The depth of review is agreed with the client.

## Approach to AI and confidentiality
The firm assesses and improves texts produced by people or AI, applying professional judgement to accuracy, clarity and suitability for the audience. Technology is used selectively where it adds value and is compatible with the client's confidentiality requirements. Assignments can also be completed entirely without AI.

## Clients
Banks, insurers, non-financial companies, regulators, public bodies and professional services firms across Switzerland. The firm works alongside internal teams and existing providers.
